Theses

  • Ph.D.: Strong Coupling Approaches for Electronic Transport and Superconductivity. Advisor: Debanjan Chowdhury.
  • M.Sc.: Quantum Szilard Engines and Breakdown of Adiabaticity. Advisor: Gabriel Tellez Acosta.

Teaching

At Cornell, I taught or graded courses in mechanics and heat, electromagnetism, oscillations/waves/quantum physics, quantum mechanics, and applications of quantum mechanics. At Universidad de los Andes, I taught or graded computational tools, computational physics, experimental physics, statistical physics, and solid-state physics.
